# DS HAIR (WigExporter) — wigexporter.com

> B2B hair supply with OEM & private-label support for global buyers. Three product families: Human Hair, Synthetic Hair, Salon Supplies. 19 years manufacturing since 2007, serving 40+ countries and 50+ brands.

## Who it is for
Global hair brands, distributors, salons, and resellers needing wholesale extensions, wigs, toppers, and salon supplies with custom colour and private-label development.

## Key sections
- [Human Hair Extensions](https://wigexporter.com/human-hair-extensions.html): Clip-in, tape-in, K-tip, weft types
- [Human Hair Wigs & Toppers](https://wigexporter.com/human-hair-wigs-toppers.html): Lace wigs, toppers, ponytails
- [Synthetic Wigs & Hairpieces](https://wigexporter.com/synthetic-wigs-hairpieces.html): Wigs, hairpieces, fringes, clip-in toppers
- [Salon Supplies](https://wigexporter.com/salon-supplies.html): Five kits, eight single products
